subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: What public sub-agent completion-announcement control should OpenClaw support for deterministic skip/suppression?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but adding public tool/config surface overlaps per-spawn skip, global defaults, per-channel suppression, and parent-session routing, so automation should not choose the durable API shape alone.

options.title: Unified announce policy
options.body: Add one opt-in policy surface that preserves current behavior by default while supporting deterministic skip and staying compatible with broader parent/per-channel routing work.

options.title: Per-spawn skip only
options.body: Expose only a `sessions_spawn` skip flag now, reducing config blast radius but leaving repeated boilerplate and per-channel defaults for later.

options.title: Defer to broader routing design
options.body: Keep this parked behind announceTarget/per-channel design so one future contract covers skip, channel suppression, and parent routing together.

recommendation.title: Unified announce policy
recommendation.body: Add one opt-in policy surface that preserves current behavior by default while supporting deterministic skip and staying compatible with broader parent/per-channel routing work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal across `sessions_spawn`, subagent announce delivery, docs, and prior maintainer-facing review discussion.
